title: Agentic Quality Engineering Architecture
summary: Specialised AI agents collaborate across analysis, design, automation, execution, review, security and delivery while human governance remains explicit.
problem: Coordinate AI-assisted QE activities without losing responsibility boundaries or evidence.
decisions: Role-specialised agents instead of one general-purpose agent
Evidence captured at execution and evaluation stages

title: Smart Test Designer Architecture
summary: RAG-powered test design combines enterprise knowledge retrieval, scenario generation, evaluation, traceability and multi-tenant controls.
problem: Generate relevant tests grounded in enterprise context rather than generic model knowledge.
decisions: Project and tenant context carried through the workflow
Export and traceability treated as first-class outputs

title: RAG Evaluation Architecture
summary: Separates retrieval, context and answer evaluation so quality failures can be diagnosed instead of averaged into one score.
problem: Identify whether poor answers originate from retrieval, context selection or generation.

title: AI Agent Evaluation Architecture
summary: Combines deterministic assertions with model-based evaluation for task, tool, reliability, safety, latency and cost signals.
problem: Agent success must be assessed beyond final text output.
decisions: Use scoring rubrics for subjective dimensions
Track cost and latency with quality

title: Playwright Enterprise Automation Architecture
summary: A layered automation platform for UI and API testing with reusable abstractions, parallel execution, evidence and CI/CD quality gates.
problem: Scale test automation without creating a brittle collection of scripts.
decisions: Clear test, page, API and fixture layers

title: MCP Integration Architecture
summary: Model Context Protocol exposes selected engineering capabilities to AI clients through controlled tools rather than granting unrestricted system access.
problem: Let AI clients invoke enterprise QE capabilities safely and consistently.

title: CI/CD Quality Engineering Architecture
summary: Quality checks are composed into delivery pipelines so functional, API, AI and reliability signals can influence release decisions.
problem: Make quality continuous and visible rather than a late manual gate.
decisions: Fast checks early, deeper checks later

title: API Automation Architecture
summary: A reusable API quality architecture for contract validation, workflow testing, authentication, data setup, evidence and CI/CD execution across service boundaries.
problem: Scale API testing beyond endpoint-by-endpoint checks into reliable business journeys and contract-aware quality gates.
decisions: Separate API clients, workflow orchestration and assertions
Treat OpenAPI contracts as testable engineering inputs
Capture request/response evidence without leaking secrets
